meta.name: 病愈连练14天
meta.placeholder: a heroic and joyful chibi girl with long black hair and big sparkling anime eyes, wearing an elegant dress with flowing mint-green ribbons, holding her polished bamboo flute high like a victory torch. A small pink bandage styled like a cute heart is wrapped neatly on her tiny finger, fading into floating sparkling golden pixels to represent full healing, surrounded by a massive burst of shimmering holographic stars, rising phoenix feathers, and colorful musical notes floating into the sky The scene marks a triumphant two-week recovery milestone, with twin celebration flames, a full phoenix rising overhead, and a small golden ribbon medal floating beside the girl.
meta.zh_story: 病愈后坚持14天。喉咙不哑了，手也越来越稳——像火炬变成小太阳，光不大但一直亮。爸妈看着不说话，因为不再需要掌声：她自己就是答案。
meta.cond_text: 宝宝生病痊愈后坚持恢复竹笛练习 14 天
